subject.title: fix(firecrawl,brave,web-search,web-fetch,models-config): use own-property checks for config field lookups

question: Should canonical Firecrawl and Brave plugin configuration reject prototype-inherited plugin entries and nested fields, matching the rule applied to legacy and core paths?
rationale: Completing the stated invariant changes compatibility for programmatically constructed plugin configuration, so the permanent trust boundary requires owner intent.

options.title: Complete the boundary
options.body: Require own properties throughout canonical plugin traversal and add focused canonical coverage.

options.title: Narrow the hardening scope
options.body: Preserve canonical inherited behavior and limit the PR’s claim to the selected legacy and core readers.

recommendation.title: Complete the boundary
recommendation.body: Require own properties throughout canonical plugin traversal and add focused canonical coverage.
